positioning.brief_for_strategy:
6 competitor(s) read - no open ground found.

**There is no open ground on the claims themselves.** Every axis this company competes on is claimed by somebody else too. That does not mean the email has to be generic - it means the difference has to come from specificity rather than from the claim: the one competitor carrying a real figure beats the four asserting the same thing without one.

**Contested - usable, but the reader has heard it.** Argue these, never assert them:
- **other** - Danny Hieber turns each Substack newsletter issue into dozens of posts for Substack Notes and six other platforms.; Josh Allan Dykstra schedules a month of posts in one day with Buffer. (2 competitor(s) also claim it).

**Table stakes - true, and worth nothing as an argument.** Every competitor says these. An email that leads on one of them is an email the reader has already received:
- **price** - Buffer Essentials costs $5 per month for 1 channel when billed $60 yearly, saving 2 months.; Free plan Insights includes Last 7 days, Last 30 days, and Month to date date ranges.; Buffer’s paid plans can be billed monthly or annually, and annual billing receives a 20% discount.; Buffer offers nonprofit and charity organizations a 50% discount on paid plans.; Buffer offers a 14-day free trial for Essentials. (4 competitor(s) also claim it).
- **security** - Foster Coffee Company achieved 30% year-on-year social media follower growth.; Kevin Indig saves 2 to 3 hours every week on content distribution using Buffer.; Foster Coffee Company had a combined social media audience of more than 15,000. (3 competitor(s) also claim it).
- **proof** - Foster Coffee Company was founded in 2013 by Jonathan Moore and Nicholas Pidek.; Foster Coffee Company uses Buffer for social media publishing.; Foster Coffee Company co-founder Nicholas Pidek said he was “really thrilled” with Buffer after evaluating social media management platforms.; Foster captures new social content weekly and plans its direction from two weeks to a month in advance using Buffer.; Foster found that planning its Buffer publishing schedule two weeks ahead was its sweet spot.; Foster marketing associate Justin Ozanich said he schedules almost exclusively through Buffer’s calendar.; Foster Coffee Company is a Michigan coffee business with two locations.; Foster Coffee Company has locations in Owosso and Flint.; Kevin Indig uses Buffer to repurpose each newsletter issue into social posts and test ideas on Substack Notes.; Danny Hieber uses Buffer to schedule posts derived from each Substack newsletter issue.; Podcaster Josh Allan Dykstra uses Buffer to schedule a month of posts in one day.; Alexandrea Bowman of Sapphire Social says Buffer’s per-channel pricing lets her remain flexible and stop paying for a client’s channel when the client is no longer under contract.; Metallica uses Buffer.; Benefit uses Buffer.; Wired uses Buffer.; Semrush uses Buffer.; Crocs uses Buffer.; ElevenLabs uses Buffer.; Pizza Hut uses Buffer.; Vice uses Buffer. (4 competitor(s) also claim it).

**Where the field is ahead of us.** Do not raise these:
- **speed** - Later, Sprout Social, SocialPilot claim this and we do not. Do not invite the comparison: an email that raises this axis loses on it.
- **breadth** - Hootsuite, Later, Sprout Social, SocialPilot claim this and we do not. Do not invite the comparison: an email that raises this axis loses on it.
- **quality** - Hootsuite, Later, Sprout Social claim this and we do not. Do not invite the comparison: an email that raises this axis loses on it.
- **effort** - Hootsuite, Later, Sprout Social, SocialPilot claim this and we do not. Do not invite the comparison: an email that raises this axis loses on it.
- **support** - Later, Sprout Social, SocialPilot claim this and we do not. Do not invite the comparison: an email that raises this axis loses on it.

**The category's own words.** Two or more competitors spend these. A sentence built only out of them says nothing about this company:
- analytics, unlimited, brand, inbox, manage, media, plan, social, track, access, advanced, campaigns, card, content, credit, free, includes, integrations, management, marketing, month, per, performance, post
